newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka up in mixed trade on Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka up in mixed trade on Latvian bourse.

text.p: Unibanka crept up again on Friday in mixed trade and dealers remain hopeful that a spate of interim results will spark gains on Latvia's listless market.
Overall market volume was down to a sluggish 62,000 lats from 136,000 lats. The Rietumu index inched up 0.13 percent to 150.53. The bourse index rose 0.13 percent to 377.43.
The performance of official list stocks was mixed, with three gaining, two easing and one holding steady.
The spotlight remained focused on Unibanka, which accounted for about half of the session's turnover as it rose to 3.17 lats from 3.15 lats.

Unibanka reversed a three-session slide on Wednesday which was prompted by the announcement that one million of the state's shares in the bank will be auctioned on July 28 at a minimum price of 3.05 lats.
The market remained divided about the bank's rally, with some dealers saying it still looked like a good buy and others speculating that someone was propping it up.
Elsewhere on the official list, Riga Shipyard added two santimes to 1.38 lats on turnover of 1,400 lats.
Dealers say it and other official list shares may post short-term gains ahead of six-month results, which are expected to be promising.

On the secondary list, Jekabpils Sugar soared for the third straight session on the strength of its interim results, which far exceeded the market's expectations. It rose to 74 santimes from 65 santimes.
